summary: Privacy & compliance testing (PIPEDA/PHIPA), backend and frontend. New suite tests/test_privacy_compliance.py has 15 tests: 13 pass, 2 fail, and both failures come from the same real bug. The bug: the driver write endpoints (POST /stops/{id}/arrive, /deliver, /fail, /verify-qr and PUT /stops/{id}/phone) return the full stop to the driver, including customer_phone and fee. These pass: encryption at rest (notes, customer_note, pod_signature and saved_notes.note are 'enc:' in Mongo and plaintext in the API; the photo upload round trip returns the original bytes and the stored object bytes are encrypted), HSTS header, driver views on GET route/routes/stops and the route websocket (no phone or fee; admin still gets them), audit log (rows for admin, merchant, driver and customer; q/role/before filters; 403 for merchant and driver, 401 without login), retention GET/PUT limits 30-3650 (422 outside) and run-retention (erases an 800-day-old stop, keeps the invoice total, blanks the invoice name), sign-up 400 without consent and consent stored with it, /me/consent GET/POST, CSV import 400 without consent=true and consent fields stored on each stop. UI checks that pass: landing, sign-up and upload privacy links open /privacy; the sign-up consent modal (checkboxes stay disabled until consent-scroll reaches the bottom, Accept stays disabled until both are ticked, then the done screen shows and the DB row has the consent fields); the driver gate (modal on drv-1's manifest, Accept sends POST /me/consent, modal stays gone after reload, Cancel signs out); the driver stop screen has no customer-phone-input; the merchant health-info-warning; the 'TICK THE PRIVACY CONSENT BOX FIRST' toast; upload with consent ticked; the admin privacy screen (rows, role chips, search, load more 50 to 100, retention save and run now); tracking unlock with the last 4 digits. Regression suites rerun after updating them for consent=true and privacy_consent; the only remaining failures are email provider 429 rate limits and steps that depend on them.

critical.issue: These return (await get_stop_or_404(id)).model_dump() unchanged, so a driver token gets customer_phone, fee, consent_* and rating_comment. That breaks the driver minimisation requirement. Reproduced in test_driver_write_responses_hide_phone and test_driver_deliver_signature_encrypted. Fix: wrap the return in driver_stop_view(...) when u.role == 'driver'.

minor.issue: Drivers can still overwrite the customer's phone through this endpoint even though the UI hides the input. Consider making the customer phone admin/merchant only.
Consent is only enforced by the client-side gate. The backend serves /drivers/{id}/route and the stop actions even when phipa_consent_given is false.

aggregate, distinct, find_one_and_replace, bulk_write and $push/$addToSet updates pass straight through without encrypting or decrypting. They are not used today, but any future use will leak or store plaintext.
Saved notes with no updated_at are never deleted (the filter is updated_at < cutoff).
Several paths are labelled 'Other' in the audit log (e.g. /api/codes/apology).

integration_issues.issue: DriverConsentGate only calls console.warn when POST /me/consent fails, so the driver sees nothing.

issues: role='merchant' always shows the 'Pharmacy Privacy & Batch Terms (PHIPA)' title and the pharmacy batch-schedule checkbox, even for non-pharmacy shops signing up.
The 'Accept & Continue' label wraps onto 2 lines at 375-390px width.
After a manual 'RUN CHECK NOW', the retention-last-run line still says 'Last automatic check'.

action_items: HIGH: Apply driver_stop_view to the responses of POST /stops/{id}/arrive, /deliver, /fail, /verify-qr and PUT /stops/{id}/phone for driver tokens.
Consider blocking driver route/stop endpoints on the server until phipa_consent_given is true for the current CONSENT_VERSION.
Show an error toast in DriverConsentGate when POST /me/consent fails.
Optional: generic merchant consent copy for non-pharmacy sign-ups; say 'Last check' instead of 'Last automatic check' after a manual run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4976 lines; split the privacy, audit and encryption code into modules.
The encryption wrapper is neat, but it only covers find/find_one/find_one_and_update/insert/update/replace. Document this or guard against other methods.
The audit middleware only logs GET requests that carry a bearer or order token; anonymous public GETs are not logged (by design).

rca_of_issue: driver_stop_view is only applied in get_stop (GET /stops/{id}) and for_viewer (route endpoints and websocket). The STOP_DRIVER action endpoints end with `return (await get_stop_or_404(stop_id)).model_dump()`, so their responses skip the filter.
